SUMMARY.md: A short-lived access token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Obtain one from POST /auth/token, which every client must be able to call again: the token expires after a fixed number of REQUESTS rather than after an interval, so `expires_in_requests` on the token response, not a clock, says when the next exchange is due.
